title: Plating
description: At the end of your turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Plating[/gold] is reduced by [blue]1[/blue] at the start of your turn.
smart_description: At the end of your turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Plating[/gold] is reduced by [blue]{Decrement}[/blue] at the start of your turn.
notes: Counter-type power that grants Block each turn. The Decrement value is 1 by default, but scales to the number of players when applied to enemies in multiplayer encounters. This power also scales in multiplayer balance.
